feature_definition: unweighted mean of the K selected frozen patch states; selector scores are used only for ranking
comparators: three exact bird-box-and-four-bin-norm matched random masks

probe.normalization: training feature mean and population standard deviation
probe.uncertain_targets: mask guess, not-visible, and missing labels

primary_contrast: Vision-CLS-selected minus Logit-Concept-selected macro attribute AUROC within stage and seed
uncertainty: paired image-cluster bootstrap of validation predictions; report three seeds and leave-one-attribute/species-out sensitivity
promotion_gate: the selector contrast must agree across seeds and remain after exact matched-random and label-shuffled controls
claim_boundary: This experiment tests attribute decodability in selector-restricted pooled states. It does not show that the frozen VLM uses that selector or pooling rule when answering.
